$comment: Temporary high/critical advisory allowlist read by the CI audit gate (scripts/audit-gate.mjs).
An entry is ONLY justified when a fix exists but is currently un-installable under .npmrc
min-release-age=7 (the patched version is published but <7 days old). Each entry MUST be
converted to an npm `overrides` pin and DELETED from this file once its fix ages past
min-release-age (see `ageInOn`). The gate FAILS on ANY high/critical advisory NOT listed here,
so the allowlist never weakens the gate for un-triaged findings. Reviewed by the Architect.

allow.runtimePath: DEV/BUILD-TOOLING ONLY, all 3 dependency paths verified via `npm ls --all`: (1) @eslint/eslintrc -> minimatch@3.1.5 (ESLint config resolution, lint-time); (2) eslint-config-next -> typescript-eslint -> @typescript-eslint/typescript-estree -> minimatch@10.2.5 (TS-ESLint parsing, lint-time); (3) @capacitor/cli -> rimraf -> glob@13.0.6 -> minimatch@10.2.5 (Capacitor mobile CLI — only a type-only `import type` reference from capacitor.config.ts, erased at compile time, never bundled/executed in the Next.js server or client runtime). All three process glob patterns from repo-committed config files (eslint config, tsconfig, capacitor.config), never from an HTTP request body or other external/user-supplied input, so the DoS (attacker-controlled expansion pattern) is not reachable in production.
